Title: Application starts successfully with new qr.bangla properties in development profile
Preconditions: application-dev.yml is deployed as the active profile, no other configuration overrides the qr.bangla section
Steps:
1. Deploy the application using application-dev.yml profile. 2. Observe application startup logs for any binding errors or missing property warnings. 2. Verify the application starts without errors related to qr.bangla properties.

Test Data: Old config: no qr.bangla section. New config: qr.bangla.guid="YOUR_BANGLA_QR_GUID", qr.bangla.signing-key="${QR_SIGNING_KEY}", qr.bangla.signature-length=16
Expected Result: Application starts successfully without binding errors or warnings about missing qr.bangla properties. No runtime errors related to missing configuration.

Title: Profile override correctly applies qr.bangla properties to both dev and prod profiles
Section: QR Code Bangla Configuration Profile Override
Preconditions: Both application-dev.yml and application-prod.yml contain the qr.bangla section with identical values
Steps:
1. Deploy the application with application-dev.yml profile and verify qr.bangla properties are bound. 2. Deploy the same application with application-prod.yml profile and verify qr.bangla properties are bound. 3. Compare that both profiles bind the same qr.bangla values.

Test Data: Both profiles contain qr.bangla.guid="YOUR_BANGLA_QR_GUID", qr.bangla.signing-key="${QR_SIGNING_KEY}", qr.bangla.signature-length=16
Expected Result: Both profiles bind the qr.bangla properties identically; application starts successfully on both profiles without binding errors.

Title: No required configuration keys were removed or renamed during the change
Preconditions: Review the diff to confirm no keys were removed or renamed, only added
Steps:
1. Compare the old and new configuration files to verify no keys were removed or renamed. 2. Verify the qr section previously existed without the bangla subsection, and now only adds the bangla subsection without removing existing keys.

Test Data: Old config had qr section with no bangla subsection. New config adds qr.bangla subsection with guid, signing-key, signature-length. No keys removed.
Expected Result: No configuration keys were removed or renamed; only the qr.bangla subsection was added. No runtime failures due to missing or renamed keys.
